paragraphs: Prepared by the structures team following the winter storm cycle. Severity uses the national bridge index conventions.
The south approach remains serviceable but moves to a six-month inspection interval until the bearing work is complete.

list_items.text: Expansion joints show normal seasonal movement
Two bearing plates require regreasing within ninety days
Deck drainage cleared and functioning at all test points
